en.title: SpaceX Nears $2.5T After IPO Surge
en.summary: SpaceX's probability of hitting a $2.5T valuation by June 30 surged to 50% following its historic IPO. The company's market cap already exceeded $2 trillion, with shares jumping 20% post-debut.
drivers: SpaceX market cap surpassed $2 trillion post-IPO (CNBC).
Shares jumped 20% on first full trading day.
Added $412 billion in value in two days (LA Times).
en.why_matters: This valuation milestone reflects strong investor confidence in SpaceX's long-term growth potential and its transformative impact on the space economy.
en.bull_case: SpaceX's market cap already exceeding $2 trillion and continued strong post-IPO rallies make $2.5 trillion by June 30 highly achievable.
en.bear_case: Current valuation might be overheated post-IPO, risking profit-taking or broader market corrections before the June 30 deadline.
